decisions: Use XRP Insights as a broad XRPL attributed-wallet custody series: balances are read from rippled account_info, while exchange attribution relies on XRPSCAN public labels.
Keep the 22.48B all-exchange attributed-wallet total separate from tradable float, order-book liquidity, customer liabilities and proprietary exchange holdings.
Separate known non-customer reserves/funds (487.2M XRP: Binance-Peg 325.8M, cbXRP 150.2M, insurance/charity 11.2M) from customer-custody interpretations.
Record cold/hot/unclassified shares separately; do not equate hot-labelled balances with immediate sellable liquidity.

Correct the Binance theft-reserve hypothesis: XRP Insights reports Binance same-wallet changes +17.6M over 7d and +30.3M over 30d; Oct30 all-exchange -207.3M was followed by +105.9M on Oct31. Causality remains unresolved.

Keep CryptoQuant's narrower exchange reserve series separate from XRP Insights' XRPSCAN-labelled broad wallet universe; do not average or treat the prior 2.58B observation as the same series as the current 2.78B observation.
Treat Binance Update #3's XRP 1:1 coverage as a primary company claim at 2026-10-31 00:00 UTC; full zk-SNARK proof and independent same-time reserve/liability reconciliation remain pending.
Do not infer XRP spot/OTC purchases from Binance's 90% aggregate replenishment claim or from the XRP 1:1 coverage claim.

Admit institutional updates (Coinbase/RLUSD, BNY custody, Aviva tokenized fund, C2FO Instant Pay, Ripple National Trust Bank, SBI multi-rail) to the event timeline only; they do not establish XRP purchases or XRP collateral balances.
Keep ETF and derivatives provider series separate; partial ETF reports and non-comparable OI universes are not directional features.
No new directional XRP feature is admitted and no forecast is issued.
required_verification: Crosswalk all five Binance incident source wallets against the exact XRPSCAN label snapshot and CryptoQuant reserve address universe.
Obtain Binance's full zk-SNARK proof and same-time October 31 XRP reserve-address/customer-liability export by the November 3 estimate.
Reconcile 2.78B Binance attributed wallets against the prior 2.58B reserve-series observation without assuming a 200M inflow.
Reproduce the 701-wallet XRPL account_info balances from public ledger state and version the XRPSCAN label set.
Obtain venue-level order-book depth, spreads and executed volumes before translating wallet balances into liquidity or float.
Reconcile complete ETF flows from issuer files and futures OI at contract level before any model admission.
